item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","findings":[{"file":"internal/engine/managed_git.go","line":123,"priority":1,"description":"When repository.json exists, configureManagedRepositoryLocked validates and returns it without reading repository.json.pending. Reproduce from managedFixture by changing pending.source (or its candidate/digest/included paths), keeping repository.json, then calling configureManagedRepository with the original request: it returns success and preserves the corrupt pending evidence. Validate every manifest that exists and require the final and pending representations to agree; add simultaneous-final-and-pending corruption cases."}],"limitations":["Review was limited to the supplied diff, sources, and evidence; per request, no tools were used and test results were not independently reproduced.","Compatibility with the three explicitly excluded dirty source files and full-checkout validation was not assessed.","The supplied evidence establishes preparation and repository flows only; it does not establish mission acceptance or provider execution."]}
